So far, nine feature flows are settled:

- Effortless saving with automatic details and preserved page/PDF copies
- Editing addresses, titles, descriptions, labels, and formatted notes
- Label browsing and powerful full-content search
- Read later and Finished lists
- Duplicate prevention
- Permanent deletion
- Reversible archiving
- Clear recovery from invalid links, unavailable pages, and search mistakes
- Scannable handling of large collections

The edge cases and interaction choices are now settled. May I start implementing this approved scope?
